# اِعْتَصَرْتَ (iʕtaṣarta) /iʕ.ta.sˤar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
# اِعْتَصَرْتِ (iʕtaṣarti) /iʕ.ta.sˤar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
# اِعْتَصَرَتْ (iʕtaṣarat) /iʕ.ta.sˤa.rat/: third-p
